Duration-bound native Effect buffs: single linked Effect, one actor recipient (target, or caster without a target), real duration, no save/area/trigger; complete Effects only

Reaction buffs: the linked Effect applies to the explicit recipient when the reaction is cast; complete, bounded Effects only; new general completeness blockers (teleport, immunity to this spell, divided among, incapacitation, spend a single action)
Area ally buffs: "You and (all) allies in the area gain" with one linked Effect, an emanation and a real duration; recipients are the caster (when named) and PF2e allies within the emanation
Basic-save and outcome phrasings: creature-type area damage, environment-only narration, terrestrial-only GM question, "As failure, plus … takes NdN TYPE damage"
Companion/eidolon/plural buff targets and native PF2e Aura Effects applied to their centre; new completeness blockers (replacement, Shield Block, size change, Sustain radius growth)
Lingering damage areas: compiled enter/turn-start/turn-end exposure over a duration, placed region or caster emanation, once per round, GM-reviewed exposures resolved as basic saves

Lingering areas: concealment inside the area (Concealed Effect following membership, attack-roll flat-check note), sustained lingering areas (Sustain obligation, missed Sustain ends), document-based emanation distance

Lingering areas with degree-of-success saves (preamble trigger grammar: cast/enter/turn-start/turn-end/Sustain, bare-subject residue check), Sustain exposure events, sustained durations without a maximum, GM-confirmed moisture immunity; caster-subject outcome clauses made residual; Stagnate Time moved from one-time save to turn-start lingering
Enemy-only subjects: enemy-of-caster target predicate (PF2e alliance, GM confirmation for neutral creatures) for one-time area saves and lingering areas; damage-first degree triggers
Different damage on Sustain: lingering sustainDamage formula (cast rank only), formula-mode shared damage rolled with PF2e DamageRoll, Sustain exposure plan
Compact degree tables (one-sentence save-or-condition outcomes rewritten to the standard table), lingering line areas, “<noun>'s space” area names, plural trigger verbs

Sustained condition lifetime: sustained degree saves with a fixed maximum; conditions without their own duration (and “for the duration of the spell”) last while the caster Sustains, ended on a missed Sustain or at the maximum; any other Sustain rule blocks

Spell attacks: single-target attack spells rewritten to a table keyed by the attack result (critical hit, hit, miss), rolled by the caster with PF2e's spell attack against each target's AC on the shared save card

Multi-target spell attacks: plural creature targets, “against each target”, shared multiple attack penalty (one attack number per card), heightening-aware critical persistent damage restated before the table

Trait-conditional extra damage: “… deals an additional @Damage[…] damage to creatures with the X trait” (inline, rank-only), rolled once and scaled by each target's result; basic saves, degree tables and spell attacks
Counteract along the ray (GM reminder on the card for the exact official wording) and fixed trait extra dice heightened from the Heightened entry with the item's interval

Pushes and pulls for spell attacks: recognised forced-movement clauses recorded per result and shown to the GM on the card (tokens aren't moved); “against your target's AC”; hit-then-critical attack sentences

Persistent damage not doubled on a critical hit (inline rank-only persistent roll added once to both hit rows); rank-reading inline formulas no longer take a second heightening from the Heightened text

Material damage sentences (silver, cold iron, adamantine) accepted only when the damage entry carries the material; “The <noun> deals double/full damage” rows; “The beam of light deals …” damage sentences

Action-count variants for spell attacks: PF2e variants (overlays) carried through the save card; action-count sentences (targets and damage by actions spent) checked against the chosen variant; variant-aware census and base-card note

Direct healing: one healing entry stated by a healing sentence, applied with PF2e's own healing roll (variant and rank) to the recipients, alone (kind healing) or with a linked Effect; action-count variants checked against the variant's healing; vitality/void eligibility

Heal or harm: one void or vitality roll that heals the creatures the energy heals (no save) and harms the others (basic save); per-variant routes (dual cast for 1 and 3 actions, direct healing and damage-only basic save for the 2-action variants) from the heal-or-harm grammar

Self / not-self Effects: a creature-kind mode list (healing entry, damage entry with a basic save) sharing one linked Effect, applied only to the recipient the text names (yourself, someone else, or the target on a failed save) and only when the Effect's own rules give exactly the stated modifier to that recipient

Spell attacks with several damage entries: a damage list naming every structured entry (including persistent entries and a variant's chosen type), rows that keep only some entries ("the electricity damage, but not the slashing damage"), extra damage by trait written as "if the target is undead", and a critical speed penalty

Persistent-linked lifetimes: a condition ("until they recover from their persistent fire damage") or Effect ("as long as the target is taking persistent damage from this spell") on a spell attack's hit rows, with no timer of its own, removed when the creature has no persistent damage of that type left

Splash damage in spell attacks: the struck target takes the non-splash damage × the result plus the splash once (never doubled); every other creature within 5 feet takes the splash on a hit or critical hit; a miss splashes no one. Also heightened condition durations ("the duration of the deafened condition increases by 2 rounds")

Spell attacks whose PF2e variant carries the text's choice: damage type from a listed choice ("bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage—as appropriate"), the needles' metal (the variant's material), the action count and range (action paragraphs, with "half damage on a failure (but not a critical failure)"), and the ranged side of a melee option

Strike-prelude spells: the caster makes the spell's Strike with PF2e (a reminder on the card), and the rest of the spell, which doesn't depend on the Strike's result, resolves by the save route; additional damage on a hit is added to that Strike's own damage roll by a generated PF2e damage-dice Effect removed after the Strike's damage roll

Strike results: a spell rider that depends on the caster's own PF2e Strike ("If your Strike hits and deals damage, … dealing 2d10 bludgeoning damage and pushing it 10 feet") is a save-card check whose result is read from PF2e's Strike attack message against the target

Strike spells carried by PF2e Effects on the caster: the Effects are applied before the caster's own Strike (Force Fling, Inner Upheaval), and with two Effects each is phased by the damage its sentence states — a one-Strike Effect that ends once the Strike is resolved, and an after-attack Effect that begins then (Fulminating Impact)

Target-dependent spell-attack adjustments: a GM question per target ("wearing metal armor or made of metal", "circumstance bonus to AC … reduced by 2") whose answer adds its bonus to that target's spell attack roll and can enable a persistent rider on a hit (not doubled on a critical hit); a cover/concealment rule the GM applies is a card reminder

Caster benefits on spell attacks carried by the linked PF2e Effect: always ("Regardless of whether you hit, you gain a fly Speed …", "You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your AC for the duration") or on a hit ("and you gain 1d4 temporary Hit Points …"), with the Effect's rules and duration proved against the clause

Spell-attack rows with narration and endings: row dice stated as the entry or twice it (full/double damage), narration after a condition's duration, an Interact action ending one condition "but not" another, and a PF2e Spell Effects link between rows restating a compiled Speed penalty

Repeated spell-attack blasts during the caster's turn (one attack card per blast from the spell's chat card, the window closing with the turn) and an attack's critical-hit follow-up save ("the target you hit must succeed at a Fortitude saving throw or fall Prone"); follow-up branches now keep linked conditions whole

Spell-attack condition riders: a hit condition and a different critical-hit condition with their own durations (an empty Target read as one creature when the attack names the target, a cosmetic mark set aside); a reaction's attack against the triggering creature dealing only persistent damage; a condition for the spell's duration ending with its persistent damage, with the removal actions as a GM reminder

Direct healing riders: targets by actions within an emanation (PF2e variants), coming back from Dying without a Wounded increase (and the ordinary Dying/Wounded rule on the direct-healing route), a reaction to a death with its limit noted, a free movement noted for the healed target, and willing-living / undead-minion target grammar

Counteract family (1): a counteract check against effects by trait, afflictions by trait (Pseudo Afflictions; DC and counteract rank suggested), the affliction chosen for a stage reduction, or any spell effect (and a GM-named area or item, artifacts failing); with damage before it, a heal-or-counteract choice, the caster as recipient, immunity negation and any-number heightening

Counteract family (2): counteracting a spell as it's cast (the GM names it, its rank and DC; automatic counteracts; a counteract rank bonus; the spell's own success outcome; Hit Points lost per rank of the triggering spell) and an item or ward (degree outcomes, artifacts failing, a restored spell slot by rank)

Counteract family (3): suspend instead of end (an affliction for a fixed time), suppress on a near miss (2 ranks) until the caster's next turn with the effect's duration paused, both through a shared set-aside marker that restores the Effect; excluded traits; heightened extra picks and added conditions; healing alongside; a possession counteract with GM outcomes

Counteract family (4): the near-miss wordings of Clear Mind and Sure Footing; a poison (affliction) or non-curse effect imposing listed conditions with the target's Drained for a +1 circumstance bonus; you and up to 9 allies with one list option for all (counteract fear or paralysis on each, or one healing roll)

Counteract family (5): light or darkness counteracted along a ray/line or where a globe overlaps, on any route — the sentence becomes a save-card reminder with a Counteract button (the caster's counteract check against the effect the GM names); a trait's extra damage written as a clause of the damage sentence

Counteract family (6): standing wards — a marker Effect tracked in Ongoing spells whose control counteracts what the GM names at the ward's cast rank each time it's triggered (a named spell; a reaction; ends after one use; a success outcome; lasting a fixed time or until the caster's daily preparations)

Counteract family (7): area wards on the caster (a rank offset for 'as if … 1 rank lower'), seeing through with the GM's secret check (blind roll, whispered; nothing ends), and a secret counteract that suppresses each illusion for the spell's duration

Counteract family (8): a lost spell slot's rank as the counteract rank with the elemental cycle checked (Elemental Counter); a counteract whose success sets off the spell's own basic-save explosion, compiled from its sentence and opened on a save card for the creatures the GM targets (Detonate Magic)

Healing / heal-or-harm (energy by creature): void or vitality by the target's creature type — Execute's variants target only the creatures their energy harms, and Divine Armageddon's single roll deals vitality instead of void to undead and void-healing creatures (GM convenience rolls set aside)

Healing / recipient mode (conjured food): the cast makes a food card holding the pieces (one more per heightened rank where the text says so) until they're eaten or the spell's or the text's time runs out; eating is PF2e's healing roll per piece at the cast rank, applied to the creature that eats, with the energy check, Dying recovery and nourishment notes (Cornucopia, Nature's Bounty)

Attack and dependent result, with the same rule's Phase 2 basic saves (bloodline damage): damage whose type PF2e sets from the caster's sorcerer bloodline — the item's DamageAlteration or DamageDice rule, or the Elemental bloodline's own alteration — checked at run time against the caster's bloodline choice and the rolled types; plus a chosen area shape as a card reminder and targets no more than N feet from each other (Dragon Breath, Elemental Blast, Elemental Toss, Flurry of Claws)

Detection / information (messaging): the caster's words whispered to the target's owners and the GM, with the text's word limit, range and one reply in its window (Message's reaction-or-next-turn window and range, Sending's 25 words each way), and a dream message held until the GM marks the target asleep, per target, with more targets when heightened (Message, Sending, Dream Message)

Phase 2 basic-save and condition saves cast through a thrall (Target '1 of your thralls'): the thrall is the caster's choice among the targeted tokens, isn't a save target, must be within the spell's range; an emanation around it or a creature within N feet of it is measured from its token, a line or cone starts from its space; a destroyed thrall is a GM reminder (Necrotic Bomb, Bone Spear, Dead Weight)

Long tail, Sustain group first: PF2e Effects that pick their rules by degree of success (ChoiceSet), applied on each offered degree with the selection preset and proved against the row's text, carrying the row's own granted condition (Distracting Decoy, Ill Omen); a degree-area trigger split across two sentences and a semicolon trait-extra clause (Fiendish Rift as a sustained lingering area)

Long tail batch 2 (mixed rules): a sustained save on the cast's own targets repeated on each Sustain with a condition held while it lasts (Interstellar Void); a condition for an unlimited duration (Eclipse Burst); conditions ended or lowered by Rest for the Night, and a condition that outlasts the spell until rest (Heinous Future, Day's Weight); a bare 'for the duration'; an Escape at the end of each turn against the spell DC (Mantis's Grasp); save-row forced movement toward the area's centre (Gravity Well); and a guard reading 'at the start of each of the target's turns' as a recurring save

Long tail batch 3 (mixed rules): 'any number of creatures' targets (Weird); a 'varies' duration with self-limiting Frightened/Sickened (Attacked from Within); a condition value rolled per creature (Wails of the Damned); degree-choice Effects with Weakness at the rank, the spell's own duration and a shorter row (Leaden Steps); stored-trigger spells that wait in Ongoing spells and open the triggering creature's save (Animus Mine, Bandit's Doom); and a fix so a self-limiting Frightened/Sickened doesn't take a timer written after another condition (Fear's dedicated route)

Long tail batch 4 (mixed rules): persistent-only damage by degree (Blood Runs Cold, Fungal Infestation, Blood Vendetta, Blistering Invective); a condition lasting until the persistent damage ends in a save row (Blood Runs Cold); a flag-choice degree Effect whose weakness scales with the degree while the persistent damage lasts (Fungal Infestation); a row Effect lasting until the bleeding stops (Blood Vendetta); a GM-answered circumstance bonus to the save (Blistering Invective); a stored trigger any number of creatures set off until the caster's next turn (Crescent Scepter); and 'As success, but <Condition N>' replacing the inherited value

Rank 1 batch 1 (spells in rank order, mixed rules): Effect proofs for sentences a PF2e Effect's rules state exactly (Ant Haul's Bulk limits, Wooden Fists' fist Strike); a caster reminder for each target that fails a basic save (Brain Drain); a GM-judged save penalty with a condition only for those targets when damaged (Thunderstrike); a degree-row Effect whose penalties and duration the row states, and 'the triggering foe' targets (Schadenfreude); a reaction whose Target field is its trigger, an instantaneous basic save that writes its own table, and condition durations rolled per creature (Split the Tongue)

Rank 1 batch 2 (rank order, mixed rules): basic-save rider leads ("it's also", a narrated participle) and an alternative area as a card choice (Spout); a critical-failure Effect whose Weakness the rider states (Frostbite); a caster question that upgrades the damage dice, skipped for PF2e's own upgraded variant, and unattended objects as a GM reminder (Cry of Destruction); save spells with one paragraph per action count, each PF2e variant keeping its own paragraph checked against its data (Concordant Choir, Disorienting Flash 2 actions, Force Rain 1-2 actions)

Rank 1 batch 3: triggers held on the cast's own target, set from the spell card with a marker on that creature — any number of times while sustained (Needle of Vengeance) or once on the target's next turn, then temporarily immune (Forbidden Thought); '1 enemy' targets

Rank 1 batch 4: penalty Effects the rows state — a degree-flag Effect's FlatModifier as 'a –N status penalty to saves against your emotion effects' / 'the penalty' defined before the table ('against creatures other than you') / 'the status penalty is –N', with an end-of-turn save that ends the Effect (Appeal to Authority); a row's own penalty Effect ending after the target's next turn, started at the target's initiative (Draw Ire)

Rank 1 batch 5: an Effect after the table whose rules a row states ('loses any immunity to bleed'), inherited by 'As success' rows and applied before the damage; a thrall 'within N feet' form; display-only inline damage options (Blood Infusion); a condition chosen by one roll for the cast, with the caster's choice on a 4 and a critical row that restates value and duration (Temporal Distortion)

Rank 1 batch 6 (Effect route): a heightened caster option to also affect the caster's allies around the target (Protection, 3rd rank); sentences a PF2e Effect's rules state for extra Strike damage dice (with PF2e ternary/gte rank arithmetic) and a trait added to Strikes, read before the recipient check (Infuse Vitality)

Rank 1 batch 7: a condition chosen per target by its highest attribute modifier (a tie across conditions is the creature's choice on the card), the row giving its value for the spell's duration, and a repeat save at the start of the caster's turns that ends it (Jealous Hex)

Rank 1 batch 8: a lingering degree-save area whose Effect reads the caster's damage type, chosen once per cast (Circle of Weakness), and a cube lasting until the start of the caster's next turn whose untyped damage takes the type the caster chooses (Astral Rain)

Rank 1 batch 9: several separate areas from an Area paragraph with a once-per-round enter and turn-start exposure (Corpse Bloom), and a 1-round concealing cloud exposed only on casting, excluding the caster, with a degree rider and a dispersal note (Noxious Vapors); unread Area paragraphs now block
Rank 1 batch 10: damage with no check applied to the one target (Force Bolt), and an area that heals allies with its Effect while enemies take a basic save (Rejuvenating Flames)

Cantrip batch 1: push rows in a degree table (Gale Blast, and Pummeling Rubble at rank 1), and terrain areas with PF2e difficult terrain on the region, hazardous terrain's entering damage and recast ending (Scatter Scree, Bramble Bush)

Cantrip batch 2: a spell attack's degree Effect ended by Escape with heightened durations (Tangle Vine), the newer-spell-replaces-the-older rule (Boost Eidolon), and a condition floor while a sustained spell is active with immunity from its end (Buzzing Bites)

Terrain batch 1: a difficult-terrain area with damage on casting and Dismiss (Cave Fangs), and PF2e's Effect data over mismatched text with a GM note (Reinforce Eidolon, Ghostly Shift, Song of Strength), per the user's decision

Terrain batch 2: inline area results with a Speed penalty until the creature leaves the area (or Escapes), difficult terrain in degree-save areas, one Escape ending a cast's Effects together, and a terrain guard on save preambles (Sea of Thought, Entangling Flora)

Rank 2 batch 1: a stated persistent damage entry in a basic save, GM-answered save bonuses and penalties (status or circumstance, several phrasings), "As success, but the effect lasts N" rows, and a narrating belief clause (Bone Spray, Calcium Rain, Feral Shades, Manifestation of Spirits)

Rank 2 batch 2: Effect-route sentences the Effect's rules state — "<Skill> checks to <Action>" bonus lists proved by action predicates (with the dim-light/darkness qualifier), and a granted attack proved by a Strike rule (Animal Feature, Spirit of the Beast, Inscrutable Mask)

Rank 3 batch 1: push rows — push-only rows, "… and knocked Prone", a missing direction when the area starts at the caster, the wall/ledge sentences as the push note, and a preamble guard for unread collision sentences (Begone, Pushing Gust)

Rank 3 batch 2 (push rows reaching rank 5): two-sentence and comma push rows with Prone, a push distance heightened by rank, the pull into the line before the saves as a GM reminder; correctness fixes (a reaction's Trigger paragraph isn't a rule, "equal to half the damage" isn't a row multiplier, a lowercase "you" clause is the caster's) (Repelling Pulse, Tornadic Gale)

Cantrip/rank 1 batch 1: narrative "While" sentences, row narration with no rule words, a restated condition ("It then remains …"), a GM row note ("uses its remaining actions"), PF2e row Effects for a ranged-attack penalty with a data note, an audibility narration (Curse of Recoil, Deathly Scream, Overselling Flourish, Haunting Hymn)

Cantrip/rank 1 batch 2: a target saving at the start of each of its turns (target-centred lingering, sustained), a same-turn "until the end of its turn" timing fix, a visual-Perception row Effect with a type data note; weapon-target Effects on the wielder with rune, property-rune and extra-dice proofs and a weapon-runes guard (Sting of the Sea, Runic Weapon, Serrate, Shillelagh, Conductive Weapon)

Cantrip/rank 1 batch 3: a one-sentence pull save ("is pulled N feet closer to you unless it succeeds") with Prone and a variant's distance, pull rows toward the caster, written spell-attack tables for "1 living creature" and "1 creature or unattended object" (Gravitational Pull, Call of the Grave, Hydraulic Push)

Cantrip/rank 1 batch 4: a behaviour rule as a GM row note beside PF2e row Effects (user decision), the critical row carrying the failure's Effect, the spell's 1-round duration for an untimed row penalty, the per-action radius sentence ; a one-sentence push save for a PF2e variant, never the base spell with other action paragraphs (Faerie Dust, Kinetic Ram)
Cantrip/rank 1 batch 5: the caster's move of an unwilling target by result ("up to 10 feet in any direction … 20 feet through a body of water") with a willing-target reminder (Tidal Surge)

Cantrip/rank 1 batch 6: note Effects (user decision) — behaviour, attitude and choices the module can't carry out become rule-less reminder Effects with the text's duration; preamble sentences explaining the noted behaviour join the note; a row Effect penalizing rolls against the caster; 'until the start of your next turn' / 'until the end of the target's next turn' spell durations; two-creature targets; a caster-elects-success reminder (Charming Push, Debilitating Terror, Hollow Heart, Command, Heart's Hook; Phantasmagoria)

Cantrip/rank 1 batch 7: an aura that grows on each Sustain (user direction), proved by PF2e's Aura radius and counter badge; a sustained Effect-route record whose Sustain raises the badge and whose missed Sustain ends the spell (Protective Wards)

Cantrip/rank 1 batch 8: spell notes (user direction; all ranks, reported apart). 330 spells with no check, damage, healing, PF2e Effect, condition or number PF2e could apply get a rule-less note Effect with the spell's rules at the cast rank, for the spell's duration (sustained maximum, unlimited, heightened duration), on the targets or, for a spell placed in the environment, on the caster with a line to mark the area on the map. Listed: the live-verified examples. Note-only spells are not counted as enabled

Cantrip/rank 1 batch 9: ground hazards (user direction). “On any result other than a critical failure, the ground in the target's space catches fire, dealing … to each creature that ends its turn in one of the squares”: a region placed over the target's squares at Finalize, run as a lingering area whose trigger deals the damage itself (no save) and which ends with the spell's duration; and the attack form “The ray deals 2d6 fire damage on a hit (or double damage on a critical hit).” (Fire Ray)

Cantrip/rank 1 batch 10: attacks repeated on later turns (user direction: repeating actions). “can repeat the attack once on each of your subsequent turns by taking a single action … After your third attack total, the spell ends.”: the chat card's Attack Again button allows one attack per caster turn up to the total, within the spell's fixed duration; attack forms “against a creature within N feet, dealing … if you hit (or double damage …)” and “causing the target to be Dazzled for 1 round if you hit. On a critical hit, you deal double damage and the target takes … persistent damage” (Biting Words, Camel Spit)

Cantrip/rank 1 batch 11: attitude changes as note Effects (user direction). Attitude links (Friendly, Helpful, Indifferent, Unfriendly, Hostile) are never conditions; a row's attitude sentences merge into one Attitude note; “If you use hostile actions against the target, the spell ends.” joins the notes; a note lasting the spell's duration follows a heightened duration; “It must attempt a Will save, with a +4 circumstance bonus if …” is the GM's save question; “unaffected but thinks your spell was something harmless …” is narration; “1 creature that could find you attractive” is GM-confirmed (Charm, Charming Touch)

Cantrip/rank 1 batch 12: Effect + note (user decision; all ranks, counted apart). 85 spells with no check whose single linked PF2e Effect the module can't prove covers the text (or can't tell who receives it) apply PF2e's Effect as PF2e defines it on the caster, the targets, or the recipient the caster picks, plus a note Effect with the spell's text; damage, healing and counteracting are never left to a note. Long durations (weeks, months, years) become days. Listed: the live-verified in-scope examples (Harrowing, also verified, is an excluded ritual)

Cantrip/rank 1 batch 13: a bare “sustained” duration is PF2e's 10 minutes (sustained spell notes: Ghost Sound, Prestidigitation, Telekinetic Hand …); Effect + note also takes one PF2e Effect applied on use (Uplifting Overture, Read the Air, Share Vision …); Effect + note plans are guided (PF2e's Effect isn't proven to carry the text). Both routes stay counted apart. Listed: the live-verified examples

Cantrip/rank 1 batch 14: numbers in spell notes. Each sentence with a number is judged: a created thing's statistics (“The plant has AC 10, Hardness 5, and 20 Hit Points.”), a situational bonus (each bonus clause says when it applies) and an ending at 0 Hit Points are the GM's (the note); an unconditional bonus to the recipient's statistic (“Your companion gains a +1 status bonus to Performance checks.”) becomes a FlatModifier on the note Effect; temporary Hit Points, resistance, Speeds and anything else keep the spell off the route. An instantaneous environment spell that leaves something in the world tells the GM to mark it. Listed: the live-verified examples

Cantrip/rank 1 batch 15: conditions without a save. A grant the text states (“The ally becomes Quickened and …”, “You Step and become Concealed.”, “You gain the Concealed condition … until the start of your next turn.”) applies PF2e's condition by GrantItem for the stated duration, plus a note (condition-note, enabled). A spell that only mentions conditions (“If the target is Grabbed …”, an Invisible object, “ignoring the target's Concealment”) can be a spell note; restoring or removing a condition never is (Allegro, Sudden Shift, Qi Rush; mentions: Invisible Item and others)

Cantrip/rank 1 batch 16: per-row durations (user direction: notes with the correct duration). When a save's rows only give the duration (“The duration is 1 minute.”, “The target is affected for 1 round.”, “The effect lasts its normal duration.”, “As failure, but …”), the non-mechanical effect before the table becomes a note lasting each row's duration; “A willing target can choose to critically fail …” / “You can allow allies to choose the outcome …” is a GM reminder. Situational-number matching also reads capitalised When/If, “to open the …”, and “reduce … to 0 Hit Points” (Forced Quiet, Clouded Focus, Penumbral Shroud; notes: Bone Shield, Protector Tree, Foresee the Path, Nudge Fate, Lock)

Cantrip/rank 1 batch 17: a row's rolled duration (“The creature is affected for [[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 rounds}.”) is rolled for each creature at Finalize (a chat roll) and sets its note's rounds; damage the target deals (“All physical damage dealt by the target … becomes nonlethal”) is the GM's, in the note (Forced Mercy)

Cantrip/rank 1 batch 18: “The target takes full damage, and vitality effects heal it only half as much as normal for 1 round.”: the row's damage, and a “Healing halved” note Effect for the stated duration (Touch of Undeath). Signal Skyrocket looked at and kept blocked: its damage applies only in an enclosed space, which the damage compile doesn't gate

Cantrip/rank 1 batch 19: “The creature falls unconscious. If it's still unconscious after 1 minute, it wakes up automatically.” (PF2e's Unconscious for that time, and a note); “The creature takes a –1 status penalty to Perception checks for 1 round.” (a generated FlatModifier on a row note); and a rank gate: a fixed-rank Heightened entry that changes the rows unreadably makes that rank and above refuse at cast time (Sleep; the gate also now protects Horrific Visage, Divine Plagues and Stormburst at their changed ranks)

Cantrip/rank 1 batch 20: “You improve the target's attitude to you by one step (…) for the duration of the spell unless it succeeds at a Will save.” as a compact save (a failure's Attitude note, heightened durations applied); “Afterward, the target is temporarily immune for 1 day.” (24 hours); Target “1 non-hostile domesticated animal” (animal trait + GM confirmation) with its restating sentences claimed (Tame)

Cantrip/rank 1 batch 21: “They become Concealed against the triggering attack and until the end of the current creature's turn.” (a condition grant timed to the acting creature's turn: new current-turn anchor); condition mentions also read case-insensitively (“The path can be visible or Invisible”, “…; if a target is Concealed or Hidden from you”) and Stealth options (“you can become Hidden to a creature even if …”) (Genie's Veil; notes: Glowing Trail, Omnidirectional Scan, Dim the Light)

Cantrip/rank 1 batch 22: “The target loses the Dying condition, though it remains Unconscious at 0 Hit Points.” (a stabilize route: Dying removed, Wounded +1, Unconscious kept, only on a dying target); spell notes allow being counteracted by another effect (not a counteract the spell makes) and an item's Hit Points and Broken state; an instantaneous note's card shows the spell's rules (Stabilize; notes: Cinder Scribe, Mending)
